verdict.rationale: Shopify's first-party webhook docs say apps can subscribe to webhook topics to receive near-real-time event data. The docs also describe using webhooks to keep apps in sync or to trigger follow-up actions, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS endpoint registration and delivery mechanics (payload signing/HMAC verification, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: it can subscribe to Shopify webhook topics as a mechanism for receiving near-real-time data about these events
Shopify webhooks are useful for keeping your app in sync with Shopify data, or as a trigger to perform an additional action after that event has occurred.
